capabilities: sync created and updated frontmatter properties with file ctime and mtime
backfill frontmatter properties across existing notes via a command
configure property names, save delay, and folder exclusions
skip non-Markdown, Canvas, and Excalidraw files
extras: Warns users to back up the vault before enabling; documents known sync-conflict issues when Obsidian runs on multiple devices; full settings reference lives in docs/configuration.md outside the README.
intentEvidence: This plugin is a simplified reimplementation of the update-time-on-edit plugin.
motivation: The author created it as a simplified reimplementation because the original update-time-on-edit plugin did not integrate well with Obsidian Publish.
problem: Obsidian doesn't write creation and last-modification timestamps into note frontmatter automatically, so authors must maintain them by hand.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a simplified reimplementation of the update-time-on-edit plugin.

summary: Frontmatter timestamp sync that keeps created and updated properties in step with a file's actual ctime and mtime.
